One Advil is all it often takes for headache relief, muscle ache relief, joint pain relief or minor arthritis pain relief, and the medicine in Advil is what doctors use most for their own aches and pains. The world's best-selling ibuprofen brand, Advil has provided safe, effective pain relief for over 35 years. sections.bodyString: 8 Large slices. Handmade fully baked. Best kosher slice in town. Conveniently stacked. The anytime pizza! A pizza store in a box! Once upon a time, in Brooklyn New York, an immigrant boy of thirteen started working in a pizza store after school. Lines and lines of customers came in to watch this young man's award-winning pizza tossing. The boy, champion pizza maker Eddie, loved making serve in the US Marine Corps during the Vietnam War. But pizza making was Eddie's passion. Upon returning home, he opened his first pizza store in Far Rockaway, NY, doing what he did best - making delicious pizza. That success was followed by another thriving pizza store on Ave. J in Brooklyn. Thereafter Eddie and his brother Ari, owned and operated the famous landmark pizza restaurant - Broadway's J-2 NYC Pizza - for over 25 years in NYC. It was one of the busiest and largest pizza restaurants in the whole world. Millions of these traditional cheesy, tasty NYC pies were being enjoyed by pizza lovers who truly appreciate quality pizza. Today, Eddie owns and operates the largest wholesale & retail handmade pizza parlor located in the Sunset Park area of Brooklyn. He's still doing what he loves the most - making the world's most delicious pizza. Only now they can be enjoyed anywhere. Eddie's legendary pizza pies are currently available across America & worldwide in the frozen food section of your local grocery store & supermarket. These 18 inch pies are cut to 8 large real pizza, store slices - handmade and oven baked delicious and great anytime, anywhere! Just heat it and eat it! Enjoy your own slice of New York City! After nearly 100 years making matzo on Manhattan's Lower East Side, we have moved to a new and modern bakery in New York. Streit's - Since 1925. The original cracker. Our Family Story: When Aron Streit came to America in the late 1800s, he had little more than a dream and the drive to make it in America - the land of opportunity. Streit's is the story of one man's dream, and one family's dedication to turning that dream into something far greater than anyone could have imagined. After nearly 100 years making matzo on Manhattan's Lower East side, we have moved to a new and modern bakery in New York. Technology may have changed but our traditions and dedication to quality have not. We want to ensure that you, your children, your grandchildren, and your friends and neighbors will all be able to enjoy the same great-tasting matzo for centuries to come. Every box of Streit's is fresh, preservative-free, tasty, with lots of love and memories thrown in. It is still family run with the same exacting standards of quality lovingly imposed by Aron Streit, also known as the man behind the matzo. sections.bodyString:
A & H delicious all beef kosher salami 14 oz. is a type of cured sausage consisting of specific cuts of meat. Historically, salami was popular among Southern, Eastern and Central European Jews because it could be stored at room temperature for up to 40 days once cut, supplementing a potentially meager or inconsistent supply of fresh meat. 

The word salami in English comes from the plural form of the Italian salame. It is a singular or plural word in English for cured meats of a European (particularly Italian) style. In Romanian, Bulgarian, and Turkish, the word is salam; in Hungarian, it is szalámi; in Czech it is salám while Polish, French, German, and Dutch have the same word as English. The name may be derived from the Latin word salumen.

The word originates from the word sale ("salt") with a termination (-ame) that in Italian indicates a collective noun. Thus, it originally meant "all kinds of salted (meats)". The Italian tradition of cured meats includes several styles, and the word salame soon specifically meant only the most popular kind—a salted and spiced meat, ground and stuffed into an elongated, fibrous casing, then left to undergo natural fermentation and drying for days, months, or even years.

sections.bodyString:
Maine Spring Water…And Proud of It.
A lot has changed since we got our start in 1845, but at least one thing remains the same: Poland Spring Brand Maine Spring Water is still sourced from our carefully selected springs in Maine.
Helping Keep Maine Beautiful
We treat each spring source with the great care and respect it deserves. Springs are regularly monitored by our natural resource managers and field experts for quality and sustainability. We’re proud to share their hard work.
What Is Spring Water Anyway?
Great question. According to the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA): “Spring Water is water derived from an underground formation from which water flows naturally to the surface of the earth at an identified location.” To be able to label our product as “spring water,” we have to satisfy stringent standards — standards we proudly meet or exceed. That’s why every bottle of Poland Spring Brand water is labeled as Maine Spring Water.

• 8-ounce/237 mL mini plastic bottle: easy to grip and lightweight
• 100% natural spring water: zero calories, no sweeteners and no artificial colors or flavors
• Contains naturally balanced minerals for a crisp, clean taste
• Every bottle is 100% recyclable (excluding label and cap)

sections.bodyString: Enjoy the benefits of refreshment with Canada Dry Sparkling Seltzer Water. With carbonation that tickles your senses, bubbly flavor that brightens your spirit and refreshing taste that satisfies your thirst, Canada Dry is the ideal companion to take on your relaxation journey. For over 100 years, Canada Dry has been creating quality beverages and mixers to enjoy any time of day. Started in 1904 with Pale Ginger Ale, John J. McLaughlin created Canada Dry Ginger Ale as a lighter version of the syrupier ginger ales that were rising in popularity during that time. Today, there are so many more ways to enjoy the great taste of Canada Dry. Made with only the highest quality ingredients, you can enjoy the refreshing taste of Canada Dry Sparkling Seltzer Water in Original, Lemon Lime, Mandarin Orange, and Raspberry flavors. This crisp, bubbly seltzer water gives you the benefits of hydration that you would get from regular water with the taste of sparkling seltzer water. This 100% all-natural sparkling seltzer water also contains no calories, no sodium and no added sugar or sweeteners. You can make delicious cocktails or simply enjoy the taste on its own over ice. When you want hydration, refreshment and great taste, open up a cold Canada Dry Sparkling Seltzer Water to enhance your day.

Seagram’s Seltzer Water brings a comfortable sophistication to the everyday, no matter how you prefer to mix it. This crisp and clear beverage with just a touch of naturally flavor evokes a sense of ease and enjoyment. It’s caffeine free so you can enjoy it any time of day or night, making it a great option to enjoy during lunch with friends or an easy way wind down at the end of a long day.
 
And if you prefer the taste on its own, Seagram’s Seltzer Water is a great, bubbly way to refresh your taste buds. With a deliciously fresh taste even by itself, Seagram’s Seltzer Water doesn’t need to be mixed to shine. And, it’s a great alternative to soda.
 
If you’re looking for variety in your drinks, or a little more flavor in your mixers, the Seagram’s brand offers a wide array of different options—including ginger ale, diet ginger ale, tonic, and club soda options. So, no matter how you like to mix, there’s a Seagram’s option for you.
 
Seagram’s Seltzer Water is at the root of good times, making every moment more special.

McLaughlin created Canada Dry Ginger Ale as a lighter version of the syrupier ginger ales that were rising in popularity during that time. Today, there are so many more ways to enjoy the great taste of Canada Dry. Made with only the highest quality ingredients, you can enjoy the refreshing taste of Canada Dry Sparkling Seltzer Water in Original, Lemon Lime, Mandarin Orange, and Raspberry flavors. Simply Lemonade is what happens when simplicity meets seriously refreshing taste. It's lemonade the way it should be, bright and with the perfect balance of sweet and tart. Full of flavor and fresh, homemade taste. No bells, no whistles, just lemonade deliciousness that delivers. 
 
We believe tasty drinks don't need to overcomplicate things, and Simply Lemonade proves it. Honoring classic lemonade, it's a beverage that's perfect for sunny afternoons, casual dinners, or anytime you're in the mood for something tangy, sweet, and satisfyingly fruity. Microwave Cooking: Place 16 oz of frozen Brussels Sprout into a casserole dish; add 2/3 cup water. Cover and cook on high setting 6 to 8 minutes*, stirring once about midway through the cooking period; if necessary stir and cook for additional 1 minute; drain, season to taste and allow standing covered for food safety and quality before serving. Stand(ing) time is important for safety and quality. Check for cold spots and continue cooking, if needed. *Times may vary from one microwave oven to another. sections.bodyString:
Wright's Mesquite Flavored Liquid Smoke, the original liquid smoke product, is a concentrate made from the actual smoke of hickory wood. Because it's concentrated, you can easily vary the amount of smoky flavor in foods, from subtle to full and robust.
Wright's Liquid Smoke delivers big barbecue taste to all your favorite foods. Try it when barbecuing meats, poultry or vegetables, or use it as a seasoning in marinades, sauces, soups and stews.
It's easy to bring real smokehouse flavor into your kitchen with Wright's. The smoke of burning mesquite is condensed and combined with spring water to create Wright's liquid smoke, a 100% natural seasoning. Enjoy real smoked flavor in minutes with Wright's.
Wright’s Liquid Smoke, which was introduced in 1895, provides slow-smoked flavor in minutes! It’s the secret ingredient steak, rib and wing restaurants use to create their most popular entrees. Now you too can add a delicious smoky flavor to your favorite dishes. On the grill, in the oven, on the stove or in a slow cooker, Wright’s Liquid Smoke can turn your home cooking into an epicurean delight! Wright’s Liquid Smoke is offered in three flavors: Hickory, Mesquite and Applewood.
Water, Natural Mesquite Smoke Concentrate.

For marinated meats, add 2 tsp per cup marinade. For burgers, mix 2 tsp per lb ground meat. For a bold flavor, add 1/2 per serving of baked beans. For a sophisticated smoked cocktail, add a few drops to your favorite drink.
